verdict.rationale: Mem0 is an SDK, CLI and platform product, so opting out of telemetry is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting with data ownership is a related privacy feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
